title: Normalized Sinc
subtitle: Special Functions · Signal processing
summary: The cardinal sine function, central to the sampling theorem.
detail:
\[ \operatorname{sinc}(x) = \frac{\sin(\pi x)}{\pi x},\quad \operatorname{sinc}(0)=1 \]

Zeros at all non-zero integers. Its Fourier transform is the rectangular function. Appears in the Nyquist–Shannon sampling theorem: a band-limited signal can be exactly reconstructed from samples at twice the highest frequency.
